journal: Berichte der Bunsengesellschaft fuer Physikalische Chemie
experimental_method: Isochoric pVT and visual phase-transition (nick-point) measurements of H2-H2O mixtures in an autoclave with two sapphire windows up to 440 C and 2500 bar.
uncertainties_stated: pressure 1 bar; molar volume 0.10 %; T_c +-0.5 C; p_c and V_c individually as printed
quality_remarks: Hydrogen loss by diffusion into the autoclave wall was checked; 40 mol-% row is extrapolated; critical-point data are not gas solubilities. The mixtures' phase-boundary p-T data are only shown in Figs 2-3 (no numeric tables).
not_extracted_tables: Figures 2-7 (isopleths, phase boundary, molar volumes, excess volumes): no numeric tables in the paper
